messages:
maria chen: quick heads-up — noticed structured function calls breaking after AWQ INT8 run on the new onboarding model. some outputs are not valid JSON, causing the router to drop tool calls. :thinking:

zhao li: can you paste an example? is this across batches or just a few outliers?

maria chen: small sample from a single batch (prompt set 'kb-search-v2') — expected function call:```json
{
  "tool": "search",
  "args": {
    "q": "battery safety lithium",
    "max_results": 5
  }
}
```observed from AWQ-int8 quantized model:```json
{
  "tool": "search",
  "args": "q": "battery safety lithium", "max_results": 5
}
```note: missing braces around args (args serialized as raw text).

alex ramos: yikes. does GPTQ or fp8 show the same?

maria chen: GPTQ and fp8 runs look fine on the same prompts. AWQ-int8 pass rate for valid JSON drops from ~98% -> ~87% on this eval set.

zhao li: could be a decoding artifact where the model emits an extra quote or drops punctuation. any diffs in tokenizer config or eos handling during compilation?

maria chen: we pinned tokenizer + same max_len. runtime logs show these lines right before the bad emit:```
[decode] softmax_temp=0.7, apply_bpe_postprocessing=true
[kv_cache] hit=0.12
```not sure if helpful.

eva (ci-bot): added test: awq-int8/structured-json/invalid-json-count -> 13 failures, started at 1769456802.

alex ramos: could it be beam vs sampling? what generation params were used?

maria chen: greedy with top_p=0.95, temperature=0.0 (should be deterministic). same config across quant configs.

zhao li: another hypothesis: quantization-induced logits noise causes the model to emit a partial JSON token sequence and then continue plain-text. i.e. it prints "args": then the inner object doesn't open.

maria chen: exact. also saw variants where arg types change — ints turned into strings: "max_results": "5" which breaks downstream typed parsing.

alex ramos: any correlation with sequence length or chunked KV cache boundary?

maria chen: yes — most failures happen when prompt+tool schema length > 4200 tokens (on our 8k partition), so crossing attention windows might be amplifying noise.

zhao li: action items: (1) create minimal reproducer that forces schema length > boundary, (2) run AWQ with per-layer clipping and nbits tweak, (3) run eval with cast-correction postprocessor to estimate recovery rate.

maria chen: started a reproducer gist (private) and kicking off a small job: `jobs/awq-json-drift-repro` (queued).

alex ramos: temporary mitigation for production: enforce schema validation at runtime and if parsing fails, route to fallback model (fp16/dedicated) and log delta. might add small post-parse heuristics to fix common cases (wrap args in braces, coerce numeric strings).

eva (ci-bot): job 98721 (awq-json-drift-repro) started on pool:eng-ml-small at 1769456930.

zhao li: please capture token-level logits around the boundary for a few failing examples — helps to see if there's a soft confidence collapse.

maria chen: will dump logits + token ids to s3 under `s3://redwood-inference/quant-repro/1769456789/` once job finishes.

alex ramos: if AWQ consistently mis-emits structured output, we should add a checklist for model onboarding: structured-output regen tests, schema pass-rate threshold >=99%, and a quantization guardrail that avoids AWQ for schemas-heavy workloads until we fix.

maria chen: agreed — filing an onboarding blocker. assigning to @zhao li to lead follow-up.

zhao li: got it. I'll coordinate experiments and update the runbook. tagging in a small playbook note: `if structured-output pass_rate < 0.99 then fallback to fp16 or gptq`. :white_check_mark:

maria chen: thanks — i'll upload logs and the failing prompt subset when job finishes. for now adding a short note to the model card: "AWQ-int8: structured-output regression observed on long prompts; use fp16/GPTQ for tool-heavy pipelines."

alex ramos: great. adding a trace link in the incident channel if we see production hits. :bug:
